flags.reason: The Card Insight guide (b4988c5) was checked on 23 October 2026 on the c8526ae build; every file the card renders is the same blob on the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02. Read against the installed source and the guide page rendered on it (31 October, headless Chrome, 1280 px), three sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Configuration “The footer is grey with a dark button, as in Figma, …” and the Primary card's “The default: a gold badge and bar, with a grey footer.”: with no AppearanceBrand on the card the default footer (AppearanceBrand Neutral, CardInsight.tsx lines 166–170) has a white surface, nudge/background rgb(255, 255, 255), on the white card, with a grey sparkle rgb(84, 89, 97) and a dark button rgb(48, 51, 56); nothing about its surface is grey (the evidence's 23 October line says grey too). /configuration/1 quotes the sentence only from “with a dark button” on. (2) Anatomy's Divider note “A 1 px rule, shown only with a footer.”: a passed divider (true or a node) stays with footer={false} (CardInsight.tsx 200–209, 282), as the guide's own States sentence and playground readout say; the Divider part rests on the divider fact. (3) The Do & Don'ts description's “… or leaves its footer empty.”: since c8526ae the Don't shows the default copy, “One line of guidance.” and “Button”, not an empty footer. Also unclear: In context's “the screen passes a new hint and no button label” means an empty footerButtonLabel (the guide's code passes '' at line 103); a label left out reads “Button”. The entry keeps the sentence and adds /configuration/9 from the evidence. Re-check these sentences on the installed build and publish the guide, then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r23, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #546.

rules.text: Set title to the finding's topic: left out, it reads “Emergency savings”.
Set subtitle yourself: left out, it reads “One line explanation here.”
Set badge to the status, or to false for none: left out, it reads “Label”.
Whenever the default footer shows, set footerBody to your hint: left out, it reads “One line of guidance.”
Whenever the default footer shows, set footerButtonLabel to the action, or to an empty string for no button: left out, it reads “Button”.
Whenever the default footer shows a button, give it the screen's action through onPressFooter: without it, the button does nothing.

examples.purpose: A savings insight on the Insights screen, the guide's In context before the plan is set: a Title for the screen and the card in a VStack. The card names the finding (the title, one sentence of context, a short status badge) and its footer gives one hint and one action; onPressFooter stands for the screen's own action behind Set up. children is left out: the guide's figure is a SavingsGoalSummary (Saved (4 months) ₹2.4L against Goal (8 months) ₹4.8L), which has no entry in this pack, so the card shows its default figure in its place, a SavingsGoalSummary captioned “Credit usage”. The screen's own figure goes in children: report that it needs one.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Insights" subtitle="October 2026" />
  <CardInsight
    title="Emergency savings"
    subtitle="Four of the eight months we suggest."
    badge="On track"
    footerBody="Add ₹10,000 a month to reach it by June."
    footerButtonLabel="Set up"
    onPressFooter={() => {}}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: Set up runs the screen's own action through onPressFooter.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title rendered in the header (left of the badge). Default "Emergency savings", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One-line explanation rendered under the title. Default "One line explanation here.", from the component source.

props.name: badge
props.description: Header badge. Pass a string to render the default `Badge` with that label, or a custom `ReactNode` for full control. Pass `false` or `null` to hide the badge entirely. Default "Label", from the component source.

props.name: children
props.description: Left out, the figure is a SavingsGoalSummary captioned “Credit usage”; since #284 the caption is black on the white card. Declared: Main content slot. Defaults to a `SavingsGoalSummary` to match the Figma reference. Pass any `ReactNode` to override.

props.name: footer
props.description: The default footer and your own footer node both get the modes { AppearanceBrand: 'Neutral', Context: 'Nudge&Alert', ...modes }: the card's own modes win, so AppearanceBrand set on the card recolours the footer. Declared: Footer Nudge. Pass a `ReactNode` to override the default inline-compact `Nudge`, or `false`/`null` to hide it.

props.name: footerBody
props.description: Body of the default footer nudge. Ignored when `footer` is a node or hidden. Default "One line of guidance.", from the component source.

props.name: footerButtonLabel
props.description: An empty footerButtonLabel with no onPressFooter gives a footer with no button. Declared: Label for the default footer's button. Ignored when `footer` is a node or hidden. Default "Button", from the component source.

props.name: onPressFooter
props.description: The default footer's button (labelled footerButtonLabel, default “Button”) does nothing until onPressFooter is set. Declared: Press handler for the default footer's button.

props.name: onClose
props.description: onClose and showClose reach the default footer's Close. Declared: Shows the default footer's close button and handles its press.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Force the default footer's close button on or off.

props.name: divider
props.description: Unset, the divider follows the footer; a passed divider (true or a node) stays when footer={false}. Declared: Whether to render a `Divider` between the content slot and the footer. Defaults to `true` whenever a footer is shown. Pass `false` to hide it, or a custom `ReactNode` to override.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: onPress
props.description: The card becomes a Pressable with role button, named accessibilityLabel, else the title; it has no pressed or disabled look. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: With onPress set, disabled stops presses; the card shows no disabled look. Declared: Disable interaction when `onPress` is set.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label forwarded to the pressable wrapper (defaults to `title`).
